about: One row per kind of person in the Biker Bar, keyed by the EnemySettings asset each Enemy points to in the player's copy. Their looks are never changed: outfit, face and Blockman body all come from PTR. Base numbers are this mod's; PTR's multipliers (ptr_sources.enemy_settings) are applied on top per person.

columns.label: Name shown when looked at
columns.baseHealth: Health before PTR's health multiplier (Minecraft half-hearts)
columns.punchDamage: Damage of one punch before PTR's attackDamageMultiplier
columns.cooldownTicks: Ticks between punches before PTR's attackSpeedMultiplier
columns.verified: Evidence from the in-game check, or 'no'
